note: Five slots, in display order. tone must match a tone in colors.json.

roles.label: Facade
roles.usage: Main walls and large panels. Basecoat the whole building in this, it carries most of the surface area.

roles.label: Structure
roles.usage: Girders, ductwork, window frames, recessed panels and roof clutter. A step lighter or darker than the facade so the shapes read.

roles.label: Hardware
roles.usage: Pipes, railings, AC units, antennas, hazard markings and weathering. Small areas, drybrush or edge highlight.

roles.label: Primary neon
roles.usage: Main signage, holo-ads and the strongest light source. Paint over a white or very light basecoat, then glaze the glow onto nearby surfaces.

roles.label: Secondary neon
roles.usage: Lit windows, edge strips, door lights and reflected glow on wet streets. Supports the primary, use it in more places but smaller.
